name: Thick Skull (Combat)
body:
You are so dense, you can headbutt an armored foe and not feel a thing. Your target, on the other hand…

Prerequisite: Toughness.

Benefit: You gain a natural attack that deals 1d4 damage (1d3 for small creatures) + ½ your Strength modifier.
